title: Libre 2 Connection issues
symptom: Libre 2 sensor has been disconnecting continuously, losing connection all the time since September 22nd. The issue persists across three different sensors, and the user is using Librelink and Xdrip+ (with OOP2) simultaneously on a Xiaomi Poco X6 Pro.
evidence_quote: Since that date, Libre 2 sensor has been disconnecting continously, loosing connection all the time.
